title: FrameCommands
description: frame.commands@1: what a composer's `/` menu offers on one site. GET /api/frame/commands?site=<host>&q= answers this. Every site offers the network's /ask (Vibe answers with sources), /do (Actor plans and runs it), /remind (Today remembers it) and /timer (the Dock's focus timer); a site adds its own from its Frame manifest's site.commands, and a signed-in person's saved composer snippets are theirs. The site's own rows come first because they fit that box, then the network's, then the person's own; a name appears once. q filters by name prefix or hint. `name` is the word after the slash (no slash), `insert` is the text a pick puts in the box, `kind` is where the row came from, and `needs_sign_in` says the command acts for a person, so a signed-out box may offer it and then sign in. A signed-out answer is public, max-age=60, held a minute; a signed-in one is private, no-store.

id.description: The site's Frame id (the icon name), e.g. live.

site.description: The site the composer asked about; null when the host is not an OpenVibe site (the network's four still answer).

name.description: The word after the slash: ask, do, remind, timer, or a site's or person's own.

hint.description: One line the composer's popover shows beside the command.

insert.description: The text a pick puts in the box: the command, a space, ready for its arguments.

kind.description: The network's four, the site's own from its manifest, or the person's saved composer snippet.

needs_sign_in.description: The command acts for a person; a signed-out composer may offer it and then sign in.
